title: Unpacking Hateful Memes: Presupposed Context and False Claims

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy in detecting hateful memes containing racial stereotypes and false claims using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) dataset.
Evaluating the detection of implicit value judgments and false claims in hateful memes targeting religious groups (e.g., Islam) using the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) dataset.
Assessing model specificity and generalization on the Harm-C dataset, which focuses on COVID-19-related hateful memes primarily targeting China.
Assessing model performance on the Harm-P dataset, which consists of hateful memes focused on US politics, to measure generalization across different hate subjects.
